html:
G'oya

Bu "orollar" masalasi. Foydalanuvchining kunlarini takrorsiz olib, tartiblab raqamlaymiz. Har bir kundan uning tartib raqamicha kun ayirsak, bitta seriyadagi kunlar bir xil sanaga tushadi: 30, 31-yanvar va 1-fevraldan 1, 2, 3 kun ayirilsa, uchalasi ham 29-yanvar. Seriya uzilsa, bu sana o'zgaradi. Keyin shu sana bo'yicha guruhlab, seriyalarning uzunligi va boshini topamiz.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, login_at::date AS d
  FROM logins
),
grp AS (
  SELECT user_id, d,
         d - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY d)::int AS g
  FROM days
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(d) AS start_day, COUNT(*) AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY user_id, g
)
SELECT user_id, len AS longest_streak, start_day AS streak_start
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, len, start_day,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY len DESC, start_day) AS rn
  FROM streaks
) t
WHERE rn = 1

Oxirgi qadamda seriyalar uzunlik bo'yicha kamayish, tenglarida boshlanish sanasi bo'yicha saralanadi va birinchisi olinadi. ROW_NUMBER bigint qaytaradi, DATE dan esa faqat integer ayirish mumkin, shuning uchun ::int.

Tuzoqlar

DISTINCT ni unutish. Namunadagi 1-foydalanuvchi 1-fevralda ikki marta kirgan. Kunlar takrorlansa, raqamlash bir qadam oldinga ketadi va seriya buziladi.

Sanani son bilan almashtirish. Oyning kun raqami 31 dan 1 ga sakraydi, yilning kun raqami esa 31-dekabrdan keyin yana 1 dan boshlanadi. Ikkalasi ham bitta oy yoki yil ichida to'g'ri ishlaydi, chegarada seriyani uzadi:

Noto'g'riWITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, login_at::date AS d
  FROM logins
),
grp AS (
  SELECT user_id, d,
         EXTRACT(DOY FROM d)::int - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY d) AS g
  FROM days
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(d) AS start_day, COUNT(*) AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY user_id, g
)
SELECT user_id, len AS longest_streak, start_day AS streak_start
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, len, start_day,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY len DESC, start_day) AS rn
  FROM streaks
) t
WHERE rn = 1

Bu so'rov 2023-12-31 va 2024-01-01 ni ikki seriyaga bo'lib yuboradi: 365 - 2 = 363, lekin 1 - 3 = -2.

Dialektlar farqi

SQLite'da kun date(login_at), ayirish esa date modifikatori bilan. g ham sana bo'lib chiqadi:

Faqat SQLiteWITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT user_id, date(login_at) AS d
  FROM logins
),
grp AS (
  SELECT user_id, d,
         date(d, '-' || ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY d) || ' days') AS g
  FROM days
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT user_id, MIN(d) AS start_day, COUNT(*) AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY user_id, g
)
SELECT user_id, len AS longest_streak, start_day AS streak_start
FROM (
  SELECT user_id, len, start_day,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY user_id ORDER BY len DESC, start_day) AS rn
  FROM streaks
) t
WHERE rn = 1

julianday(d) - ROW_NUMBER() ... ham ishlaydi: julianday kunni kasr son qilib beradi, seriya ichida ayirma bir xil qoladi.
